Priya: Quick idea — weekend poll. If our models were office mascots, which would they be? :dog: :cat: :robot_face: Drop one-liners + emoji. I'll start: tiny-embedder = pocket gremlin that steals pens. :memo:
Evan: gpt-3.5-ish = the over-caffeinated intern who writes long emails with 2% more confidence. :coffee:
Sam: the big LLM in prod = stoic office dog: brings snacks, occasionally drools tokens. :dog:
Jordan: retrieval-augmented model = librarian with 17 tabs and a label maker. :books:
Maya: quantized-only-on-weekends model = cat: sleeps on your keyboard but does it with style. :cat:
ops-bot: poll created: 6 options — dog, cat, librarian, gremlin, robot, koala. Vote with reactions!
Priya: also imagine their Slack status: `tiny-embedder: "napping on cache"` ; `prod-llm: "serving SLOs"`
Evan: code snippet of mascot manual:
```
if model == 'prod':
  feed_treats(hours=2)
elif model == 'tiny':
  leave_note('did you clear cache?')
```
Jordan: 10/10 would put a tiny sweater on the prod-llm. :sweater:
Sam: nominate 'prod-llm' for Employee of the Month. :trophy:
Maya: also, who waters the office ficus? I'm convinced the ficus is actually a distillation model. :seedling:
Priya: @Sam @Jordan we need a mascot sketch for the all-hands slide — anyone doodle skills? :art:
Sam: I can doodle stick-figure mascots. low-res, high charm. :thumbsup:
Evan: +1 for koala variant — sleeps while holding tokens. :koala:
Maya: Officially requesting the gif of a model typing with a coffee. @ops-bot can you find one? :eyes:
ops-bot: here's a search result: `giphy.com/model-coffee` (preview suppressed)
Priya: ok that's enough chaos, thread locked to high-quality memes only. :laughing:
